findings.summary: The mutation experiment records red = (exit_code != 0) with no green control run on the unmutated copy, so any environment failure inside the one-shot copy -- uv sync --frozen on a cold cache, a tar/venv fault, or the 3600s timeout returning 124 -- marks every target red and the gate's verify_mutation_receipt passes obligation 5 on a receipt where no test ever executed. This is fail-open in the one mechanism S12 exists to make self-correcting; the module is otherwise scrupulously fail-closed (faulted_experiment). Not a violation of a spec clause -- the spec states the criterion as 'delete it and the frozen acceptance must go red' and the code implements exactly that -- so it is recorded rather than blocking.

The enumeration regex's lookbehind (?<![.\w]) excludes every attribute/method call, so an added production line such as `path.write_text(...)`, `shutil.rmtree(...)` or `self._collect(x)` yields no mutation target at all -- the enumerated set is not the 全集 of new production call sites the spec's negative criterion names, and a newly added, wholly uncovered method-call line passes obligation 5 silently. The docstring above it claims chained calls are 'still one target', which is not the behavior for `a.b()`. Scope caveat: per the spec's lineage note this function was delivered by an earlier generation and sits in the base, outside this single's narrowed S12 delivery surface, which is why it is not blocking here -- but it is the substrate the new final_review experiment consumes.

S12.5's letter requires rc/rf review.json themselves to carry checked/verified_items; the implementation persists the checklist in engine-side sidecars (continuous-review-checked.json, final-review-mutation.json) beside the sealed receipt instead, because the plugin receipt schema is pinned and cannot grow a field. The substance is enforced -- declared_review_defects refuses the seal without it, and the gate's merged receipt view refuses a receipt missing it -- so this is a documented deviation from the letter only, with the reason recorded in the code.

Carried forward from the continuous review and still unresolved: no production writer exists for .dd-evidence/regression-baseline.json -- the collector only loads it and development_create records no baseline -- so on a real awaiting_gate single obligation 6 fails closed and the self-gate derives REJECT until a baseline is hand-recorded. The spec permits gate-time or create-time recording; neither is implemented. Base surface outside this diff's narrowed scope, and fail-closed, but the positive self-APPROVE path cannot fire in production without it.

The final_review mutation experiment runs only when the stage outcome is APPROVE, so a REJECT final review seals no mutation receipt, while S12.3 reads unconditional. Substance is preserved -- the gate's obligation 5 then fails on the missing receipt and delivers REJECT anyway, and the receipt exists exactly when it is needed to authorize an APPROVE.

Review-coverage disclosure, not a defect in the change: the prescribed product-consistency command `git diff --exit-code 7e8400dc..38b28db7 -- . ':(exclude).dev-dispatch'` was not executed. This reviewer has read-only file inspection only and shell access to the worktree path is refused in this environment, so no git or shell command was run. Consistency was assessed by reading the checked-out tree, where .dev-dispatch/ is the sole reserved namespace present and no product divergence was observed; the deterministic verdict seal verifies the actual Git HEAD independently.
